_comment: Copy to firebase.json (same directory) and fill in. That file is gitignored.
This one file configures BOTH the server and the browser, so deploying is
one scp and a restart: no .env edit, no Angular rebuild.
serviceAccount: Firebase console -> Project settings -> Service accounts ->
Generate new private key. Paste the WHOLE downloaded object here. SECRET.
web: Project settings -> General -> Your apps -> Web app -> Config,
plus vapidKey from Project settings -> Cloud Messaging -> Web Push
certificates -> Key pair. These six-plus-one are public by design.
Remove this _comment key if you prefer; it is ignored either way.
